_speed: progress multiplier by how many roots. Every new save is 五行杂灵根 (5, as slow as 伪 4); 天 1 · 地 2 · 真 3 · 伪 4 stay for saves read under the retired rules.
_born: 灵根 from the 生辰 (rules/roots.mjs): the hero is always 五行杂灵根 — all five roots, each weak (Hanli, 2026-09-28). The birthday decides only the root that leads (`root_main` on the save, the stone's brightest colour): the three pillars — year (turning at 立春), month (turning at each month's 节) and day — give six characters, each an element, and the one seen most leads, a tie broken by a seed from the save's start. Skipped, five even colours and none leads. Measured over every birthday 1950–2015 (days 1–28, five save seeds): 土 39.1% · 火 17.7% · 水 15.5% · 木 14.5% · 金 13.1% — 土 leads most, as 辰戌丑未 are four of the twelve branches; 41% of birthdays tie and take the seed. The leading root is what the 渡劫 五行 factor, a fight's 主灵根 (when no 命格 is set) and a chance card's element read. `names` 1–4 are kept only for saves read under the retired rules. `color` is the stone's light for each root. The birthday is never kept.
_fate: 命格 — a lifelong base tone beside the 灵根, set once and only if the player wishes: 生肖 from the birth year, turning at 立春 (by the day — no hour is asked), and 日主, the day's heavenly stem, whose element the player is at home in. `zodiac` from 甲子 1984 (rat); `stems` in order, a day's stem is (JDN + 9) mod 10; `lichun` is the February day of 立春 for each year from `from` (checked against lunar-python). The birthday itself is never kept.

fate._branches: The twelve earthly branches' elements, 子 first.
fate._jie: The day of each month's 节 — the month pillar turns there (January's 小寒 … December's 大雪; February's comes from `lichun`). Fixed days: a day off at the edge in some years.
